title: Review panel, round two: consolidated verdict
verdict: Not ready for public launch. Recommended: a closed pilot at KLIA once the team runs CI with its TBT budgets (met or agreed anew), makes commercial measurement durable (E-17) and fixes status-line semantics, day-of-travel residuals and the one-fact-one-answer defect, and MAHB connects the official flight feed and names an owner for notices (the business lens's conditions, re-review-business.md section 7; adopted by the panel as judgement).
caveat: Expert judgement by three independent lenses on a working prototype with demonstration data; not a user study. No passengers, disabled participants or physical screen readers; Chromium only; one clock time. ux, flight, mobile, nav, ai and ui are scored as if production data were connected; info and commerce on what exists. Performance is lab data from verification.md round three, not re-measured and not field data.
method: Median per dimension across three independent re-reviews (business, design, inclusion); weights ui 10, ux 20, info 15, flight 15, mobile 10, nav 10, ai 10, commerce 5, perf 5; percent = sum(weight x score) / 5.

business.projection_judgement: about 80% with the MAHB launch gates closed

design.projection_judgement: about 80% with team fixes; about 85% with MAHB data as well

inclusion.lens: Accessibility specialist and Malay-speaking first-time traveller
inclusion.projection_judgement: about 79 to 80% with MAHB accessibility data and team fixes

disagreements.note: Half a point only (no dimension differs by a point or more). Chair check: smoking 0 results, two results titled only "Fast Track", taxi lists the liquids and power-bank rules; evidence supports the 4.0 median.

comparison.round_one_source: docs/qa/panel/panel-summary.md (mean of three reviews; not stored in matrix.json)
comparison.composite_note: Computed by the chair from matrix.json per-dimension scores (maximum over the ten benchmark airports, MAHB excluded); the figure itself is not stored in the matrix.
comparison.figures_checked_against_matrix: MAHB 42.5 and Heathrow 79.0 match airports[].weighted_pct; composite 83.0 recomputed; no correction needed.
comparison.matrix_position: Level with Incheon (74.5); behind Heathrow 79.0, Haneda 77.5, Schiphol 77.0, Istanbul 76.5, Changi 76.5, Hong Kong 75.5; ahead of Dubai 71.0, Hamad 69.0, Munich 66.5, MAHB 42.5. Differences up to about 3 points are within the method uncertainty.

weaknesses: No live operational data, and status lines that overstate freshness: all flight, gate, queue and space figures are demonstration data and the official provider throws; notices are a code file needing a deploy; status lines are inferred from notice titles, stamped "Checked hh:mm" with the current time and default to "No disruption reported" (chair confirmed). Team (semantics) and MAHB (OOS-01, OOS-02).

Content depth and operator-grade sourcing (info 3.0, high confidence): only KUL (17 URLs), PEN and BKI (6) go beyond an overview and board; Kuching and Langkawi answer 404 for transport and parking; 17 STOLports are directory cards; 8 outlets; lounges without price or rules; Fast Track details not published; third-party sources for MAHB's own building; draft Malay. MAHB (OOS-05, OOS-06, OOS-08, OOS-14).

Nothing can be bought and measurement is partial (commerce 2.5, level with MAHB today): no basket, lounge booking or B2B channel; the main parking and facilities Fast Track links are untracked; metric counts are in server memory; payment=() and script-src 'unsafe-inline' would block a checkout. Team (E-17, E-09) and MAHB/partners (OOS-03, OOS-04, OOS-13, D-17).

Assisted travellers still lack the facts and the assistance flow misleads: accessible toilets, lifts, step-free transport, accessible bays, the airport assistance service, AirAsia rules and citizens' immigration guidance missing; past steps announced "Done: Arrange assistance"; no warning inside the notice period; needs control about eleven screens down at 125% text; accessibility statement out of date. Team (wording, placement, statement) and MAHB/airlines/Immigration (OOS-07, D-04, D-07).

Day-of-travel residuals: the home card shows a past arrive-by time as "Next" (business at 18:21, design at 18:35); the delayed MH 1698 mixes original and new check-in times; the next-step card omits the delay. Team.

Concierge and search do not always answer the question asked, and surfaces disagree: fallbacks present unrelated items as related (weather gives KLIA Ekspres); access qualifiers and named airlines missed (AirAsia wheelchair gives the Calm Room); template grammar; answers 500 to 2,301 px tall on a phone; concierge says parking rates are not verified while the page shows a verified daily maximum; "smoking" returns 0 results, two results titled only "Fast Track", "taxi" lists the liquids rule (all chair confirmed). Team.
Alerts do not reach a passenger whose browser is closed; no push on iPhone outside an installed web app; e-mail is a demonstration. MAHB/partners (OOS-10).
Density and label noise (A-14 not verified): flight page 20 provenance chips, 10 Demo labels, 6 source toggles; facilities 21 source toggles; home about 70 upper-case labels and 12 type sizes. Team.

Answer-first unfinished and layout defects on phones and at zoom: transport fare 1,821 px, transit verdict 1,186 px under the form, overview flight search 2,175 px, desktop first board row 938 px; pages up to 17,436 px; map route chip covers its disclaimer on phones (new, chair reproduced); sticky concierge form at 400% zoom hides the focused suggestion; clipped chips and Malay mid-word breaks. Team.

Release engineering and performance unproven [verification]: TBT over 200 ms on 7 of 10 pages; guidance pages over the 500 KB budget; congested Wi-Fi LCP 2.57 to 2.68 s; CI, WebKit, chaos and contract tests never run; enforced CSP keeps unsafe-inline; rate limiting depends on the host declaring its client-address header; no usability study or assistive-technology test with people. Team (A-09, E-01, E-02, E-03, E-06, E-09) and MAHB (OOS-11, OOS-15).
launch_blockers: TEAM: Status-line semantics until a feed exists: drop "Checked hh:mm" on notice-derived lines, show the notices' as-of date, and show "Status not available" rather than "No disruption reported" when no current source exists.

TEAM: Day-of-travel residuals: the home card and My journey show the deadline that still matters once the arrive-by time has passed and never a past time as "Next"; delayed flights on one time basis with the delay in the next-step card; no "Done:" for steps the traveller must confirm; a warning inside the airline notice period; corrected English.
TEAM: One fact, one answer: the concierge and help FAQ read parking rates from the same records as the parking page, with a content test that fails on disagreement.

TEAM: Concierge: a fallback that says it cannot answer and names the official contact; honour access qualifiers and the named airline in English and Malay; fix template grammar and the "In effect" label; cap phone answers to a lead line and two cards (B-08).

TEAM: Search relevance (A-12): terminal in repeated titles, "smoking", "wifi", "taxi", "not published" first for accessible-toilet queries, news down-ranked, the home "parking" suggestion, and no "0 flights found" announcement for topic queries.

TEAM: Answer-first and placement: transport fare above the warning, transit verdict at the top or sticky, desktop board first row above the 900 px fold, Follow and My needs within the first two phone screens, map route controls above the map and the chip off the disclaimer, zoom sticky offsets, chips that wrap, no Malay mid-word breaks.
TEAM: Density (A-14): one source list per section, one Demo marker per view, fewer chips.
TEAM: Thin and directory-only airports: hide the empty journey-mode switcher, show the operating airline and the airport contact, and label content depth per airport on /en/airports.

TEAM: Measurement (E-17): data-handoff and a campaign parameter on every commercial link (main parking link, Fast Track on facilities and the timeline, lounge operators, rail tickets); a durable aggregate metric store.

TEAM: Accessibility statement (current focus behaviour, test scope including 200% and 400% zoom, review date, contact and response time, both languages) and the Malay copy pass (task-based home h1, Malay concierge name, shorter placeholder).

TEAM: Performance and release gates: TBT under 200 ms on the home, overview, board, transport, parking and map or agreed revised budgets; byte, request and congested Wi-Fi LCP budgets; CI with WebKit, chaos and contract tests, security and Lighthouse gates (A-09, E-01, E-02, E-03, E-06).
TEAM: Per-route CSP and payment policy for any future checkout (E-09).
TEAM with MAHB: Moderated usability study on phones in English and Malay including NVDA, VoiceOver on iOS, TalkBack and magnifier users; MAHB recruits and signs off (OOS-15).
MAHB: Official flight feed behind the provider interface, with the failure states proven against it (OOS-01).
MAHB: Operations status feed and a notices CMS with bilingual approvals, scheduling and audit, a notice live in under 5 minutes without a deploy, and a named operations owner (OOS-02).
MAHB: Official parking tariff from the barrier rate source and a booking deep link accepting product, dates and a referral code (OOS-03).

MAHB/partners: Fast Track seller, price, hours and checkpoints; lounge access rules, prices and booking; merchant or referral agreements, partner referral codes and confirmed conversions (D-02, OOS-04, OOS-13).

MAHB: Content minimum for every international airport, Kuching and Langkawi first (transport, parking, facilities with hours and location, lounges); concessionaire directory feed; airport classification confirmed (OOS-05, OOS-06).

MAHB/airlines/Immigration: Located accessibility facts for KLIA T1 and T2 and step-free status of every transport mode; the airport assistance service and CARE hours; AirAsia, AirAsia X, Batik Air and other main carriers' assistance rules; Immigration wording for departing citizens; taxi, rail and e-hailing places on a surveyed map (OOS-07, D-04, D-07, C-08).
MAHB: Operator-grade sourcing with MAHB as the source for its own building and services; brand, legal and native-Malay review; approval of the concept brand line (OOS-08, OOS-14).
MAHB/partners: Alert delivery by web push including iOS, and by e-mail (OOS-10).
MAHB: B2B enquiry channels (D-17).
MAHB: Hosting edge limits, the client-address header declared, security.txt, and field Core Web Vitals on a mid-range Android before launch (OOS-11, OOS-12, OOS-15).

post_review.title: After the re-review: round four
post_review.note: The panel has not re-scored or reviewed the round-four build. Its scores, verdict and the rest of this file are its judgement of the round-three build and are unchanged; this object records verification status only and implies no score change.
